vid_urls.title: Total solar eclipse 2026: Coming to Europe (Official broadcast)
vid_urls.description:
Watch live with us as a total solar eclipse becomes visible across parts of Europe on 12 August 2026.

The path of totality will sweep across Greenland, Iceland, Spain and a small area of northeastern Portugal, while much of Europe will experience a partial eclipse.

A total solar eclipse occurs when the Moon passes directly between Earth and the Sun, completely blocking the face of the Sun.

Join us live from the Observatorio Astrofísico de Javalambre in Spain, a world-class astronomical observatory located within the path of totality, where scientists, astronomers and special guests will explore the science behind eclipses, the Sun and their wider relevance for space science and Earth.

vid_urls.title: NASA Astronaut Chris Williams Postflight News Conference (Aug. 4, 2026)
vid_urls.description:
Tune in as astronaut Chris Williams recaps his eight-month mission aboard the International Space Station. 

After logging 241 days aboard the orbital laboratory, Williams returned to Earth on July 26, 2026. During his mission, he contributed to a wide range of scientific investigations and technology demonstrations, including research on new cancer treatments and manufacturing materials used in high-performance computers and electronics.
 
Learn more about the science Williams conducted: https://go.nasa.gov/4fjNCry
Learn more about the International Space Station: https://www.nasa.gov/station

Credit: NASA

The four members of NASA's SpaceX Crew-13 mission to the International Space Station, targeted to launch no earlier than mid-September, are talking about their upcoming journey in a news conference from NASA's Johnson Space Center.

- Luke Delaney, pilot, NASA 
- Joshua Kutryk, mission specialist, CSA 
- Sergey Teteryatnikov, mission specialist, Roscosmos

vid_urls.title: U.S. Spacewalk Preview News Conference (July 30, 2026)
vid_urls.description:
August will be a month of spacewalks. Tune in and find out what's happening!

NASA experts are speaking about three upcoming spacewalks outside the International Space Station in a live news conference taking place at NASA's Johnson Space Center. These spacewalks, currently scheduled for Aug. 6, Aug. 13 and Aug. 25, will make upgrades and repairs to the orbiting laboratory.

Participants include: 
- Bill Spetch, deputy manager of Commercial, Low Earth Orbit Program
- Chris Dobbins, spacewalk flight director
- Chloe Mehring, spacewalk flight director 

Learn more about our upcoming spacewalks: https://www.nasa.gov/news-release/nasa-to-cover-three-us-spacewalks-host-preview-news-conference/
Get daily updates from the space station: https://www.nasa.gov/blogs/spacestation/
